about.title: A Legacy of Sweetness in the Heart of Konaseema
about.subtitle: Serving Amalapuram with Pure Cow Ghee and Traditional Recipes for Over 3 Decades
about.description: Welcome to Sri Ganapathi Sweet House, Amalapuram's beloved destination for heritage Andhra sweets and crunchy savouries. Nestled by the vibrant Clock Tower area, we prepare every delicacy using time-honored Konaseema culinary traditions, 100% pure dairy ghee, premium jaggery (bellam), and hand-picked dry fruits. From our famed melt-in-mouth Kaja and whisper-thin Pootharekulu to festive Motichoor Laddus, every bite brings the warmth of East Godavari celebration.

sweets.name: Kakinada / Madatha Kaja
sweets.description: Multi-layered crispy pastry soaked in fragrant cardamom sugar syrup, with a juicy burst in every single bite.

sweets.name: Bellam Dry Fruit Pootharekulu
sweets.description: Paper-thin wafer rolls made from rice batter, generously filled with organic jaggery, pure ghee, and roasted cashews.

sweets.name: Ghee Motichoor Laddu
sweets.description: Tiny golden gram-flour pearls fried in pure ghee, bound with rich cardamom syrup, saffron strands, and melon seeds.

sweets.name: Special Ghee Mysore Pak
sweets.description: Luxurious besan sweet with a porous, melt-in-mouth honeycomb texture steeped in golden country ghee.

sweets.name: Golden Saffron Jangri
sweets.description: Intricately swirled urad dal rosettes fried to golden perfection and soaked in rose-infused saffron syrup.

sweets.name: Royal Shahi Gulab Jamun
sweets.description: Tender khoya dumplings gently fried and soaked in warm, fragrant cardamom and rose petal sugar nectar.

sweets.name: Nethi Bobbatlu (Puran Poli)
sweets.description: Traditional thin artisanal flatbreads stuffed with sweet chana dal, jaggery, cardamom, and toasted in pure cow ghee.

sweets.name: Bellam Sunnundalu (Urad Dal)

sweets.name: Nethi Nuvvula Ariselu
sweets.description: Classic festive sweet made with newly harvested rice flour, jaggery syrup, toasted white sesame seeds, and ghee.

sweets.name: Godavari Special Badam Halwa
sweets.description: Rich golden halwa simmered with crushed California almonds, pure saffron milk, and pure ghee.

sweets.name: Special Konaseema Mixture
sweets.description: Crispy besan sev, boondi, roasted peanuts, cashews, fried curry leaves, and secret Godavari masala blend.

sweets.name: Crispy Ring Chekodilu
sweets.description: Crunchy golden ring treats made with rice flour, ajwain, sesame, and mild spices. Perfect with tea.

reviews.name: Suresh
reviews.text: Best traditional sweets in Amalapuram! The Madatha Kaja and freshly made Pootharekulu with pure cow ghee are simply unbeatable. Outstanding taste, fresh aroma, and courteous service every time.

reviews.name: Lakshmi
reviews.text: Authentic Godavari ruchulu! We ordered bulk gift boxes of Bellam Sunnundalu and Ariselu for our daughter's engagement, and all our guests praised the pure ghee flavor. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ramesh
reviews.text: The Mysore Pak melts right in your mouth without feeling overly sugary. Very clean, hygienic shop located right in the heart of town near Clock Tower. A must-visit sweet house.

reviews.name: Praveen
reviews.text: Ordered special Motichoor Laddu for Vinayaka Chavithi pooja. Truly divine taste with real saffron and dry fruits. Freshness and quality are consistently high here.

reviews.name: Bhavani
reviews.text: The dry fruit Bellam Pootharekulu and hot freshly prepared spicy mixture are top-tier. Sri Ganapathi Sweet House preserves authentic Konaseema culinary heritage with pride.

reviews.name: Venkatesh
reviews.text: Whenever I travel from Hyderabad back home to Konaseema, I make sure to stop here to parcel sweets for my colleagues. Outstanding quality, prompt service, and reasonable rates.

faqs.q: Do you deliver sweets outside Amalapuram?
faqs.a: Yes! We ship well-packaged sweets across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana via courier, and also take WhatsApp orders for home delivery across Amalapuram town.

faqs.q: Are all your sweets prepared with pure cow ghee?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our ghee sweets are prepared exclusively with unadulterated pure cow ghee and traditional ingredients without artificial flavorings.

faqs.q: Can we order customized gift packs for weddings and functions?
faqs.a: Yes, we specialize in bulk orders, decorative festival boxes, and customized sweet boxes for weddings, housewarmings, and temple events. Contact us on WhatsApp (+91 99858 27779) for special volume pricing.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life of Pootharekulu and Kaja?
faqs.a: Our Pootharekulu stay fresh and crisp for up to 25-30 days when stored in an airtight container at room temperature. Kaja is best enjoyed within 7-10 days.
